1879052210.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Lesser Giant Eagle)
1879052210.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879060786.name: Knowledge of Cures
1879060786.desc: Cleanse multiple wounds, diseases, poisons, or fears from an ally.

1879060914.name: Cry of the Chorus (Melody)
1879060914.desc: This skill provides you with three power ballad bonus effects allowing access to Anthems and Codas. It also breaks any silence effects on you.

1879064370.name: Quick Shot
1879064370.desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.

1879073714.name: Field Promotion
1879073714.desc: You single out an ally to support and protect them in the midst of battle.

1879090226.name: Stomp
1879090226.desc: Bring foot up, put foot down, puny things fall over. Sometimes, things get hurt easier after.

1879102642.name: Engage
1879102642.desc: Draws enemy threat, making you the target's most threatening opponent.

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you are hit by an attack, your Block/parry Ratings will increase by X.
DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.
Up to once per second, when you Block or Partially Block:

1879139378.name: Fire Under The Mountain
1879139378.desc: Your damage and Power regeneration are increased. This skill can only be executed during combat when you have greater than 20% Morale. It can only be maintained if your Morale does not drop below 20%.

1879215026.name: Poor Map to Lugazag
1879215026.desc: A poorly drawn and undetailed map to Lugazag.

1879229234.name: Envenom
1879229234.desc: You strike at your ensnared prey.

1879232690.name: Stone
1879232690.desc: Turns the troll to stone for 15 seconds

1879241650.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879241650.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline focuses your attention on the harmonious relationship between the aspects of nurture and nature; bolstering self, allies and war-steeds while maintaining a measure of offensive capacity.

1879244850.name: Defence of the Eorlingas
1879244850.desc: You focus on defence through offence, reducing the target's armour and increasing your damage for a time.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Shield effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Shield the Flank.</rgb>

1879263922.name: Knowledge of the Rune-keeper
1879263922.desc: You impart wisdom of the ways of old unto your allies, showing them that knowledge is, in fact, power.

1879269682.name: Sneaky Trick: Enrage
1879269682.desc: Cause enemies in a large area to take more damage and prevent them from using most ranged attacks.\n\nLimit: One Trick per target.

1879297074.name: Rune of Restoration
1879297074.desc: Places a healing Runestone upon the ground, healing nearby allies. This skill can be placed at range.

1879343922.name: Summer Flower Kite
1879343922.desc: Brings out a summer flower kite for you to fly in the wind.

1879391410.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Elvish Shield-maiden)
1879391410.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879403698.name: Phial of Eärendil's Light
1879403698.desc: Wield the phial of Eärendil's light against Shelob when she is vulnerable to weaken her!

1879412018.name: Goat of the Threshold
1879412018.desc: A goat from Amdân Dammul, the Bloody Threshold.

1879420850.name: Nether-hound
1879420850.desc: Summons a nether-hound to help you search caverns and other tight spaces.

1879440178.name: Craggy Slug
1879440178.desc: Summons a rugged slug to keep you company.

1879445170.name: Light Grey Squirrel
1879445170.desc: A little squirrel who would like to see the world with you.

1879457074.name: Charming Feline
1879457074.desc: Summons a charming fluffy cat to accompany you on your journeys.

1879469362.name: Elusive Catch
1879469362.desc: You provide a bonus to your Fellowship's Evasion and Stealthiness.

1879469746.name: Jugglery Proficiency
1879469746.desc: You've always got extra bits and bobs in your haversack, and you're experienced at mixing them into your other concoctions.

1879486002.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Hobbit-lad Bounder)
1879486002.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879491122.name: Wizard's Frost
1879491122.desc: A basic sigil which chills your foe.\n\nIf this skill is used whilst your companion flanks the enemy, your Morale will be healed.

1879526578.name: Prepared: Wisp of Acid
1879526578.desc: The wicked have learned to recover magical sustenance from the infliction of pain.

conditionalEffects.description: Acid Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Pitted Armaments effect if present, up to Tier 3.

1879529522.name: White-necked Fawn
1879529522.desc: Summons a white-necked fawn to accompany you on your travels.
